en-CA.name: Speech Coach
en-CA.summary: Speaking drills graded from your own wearable.
en-CA.description: A personal speaking coach. It runs short drills that your Bee wearable grades from your own voice, tells you how you are doing, and turns opt-in live coaching on or off. Development skill.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask speech coach how am I doing
Alexa, ask speech coach to turn on live coaching
